capabilities: Create and edit mind maps saved as .smm.md files
Link nodes to Obsidian notes and local files
Attach, upload and compress images on nodes
Switch between mind map and outline mode
Export maps and embed previews in Markdown
extras: A paid professional version and a separate desktop client exist and are sold separately; mobile support is described as not yet complete; no standalone window editing; some UI components do not follow Obsidian theme colors.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build and edit visual mind maps, and a plain Markdown outline cannot be rearranged as a diagram.

relations.evidence: The underlying of this project is based on open-source projects mind-map

summary: Mind map plugin that stores maps as .smm.md files, with node images, Obsidian links, an outline mode and image export.
